findings.desc: quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/core/capability-release.ts:1 imports execFileSync from node:child_process but never calls it anywhere in the file (verified via grep - only the import line references the name).

quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/handlers/done-effects.ts:271-284 (runArtifactReleaseLedgerAfterDoneMerge) is dead code after this diff: both internal call sites (done-effects.ts applyDoneMergeEffects and done-recover.ts) were switched to runArtifactReleaseLedgerAfterDoneMergeDetailed, and grep across the repo (excluding dist/node_modules) finds zero remaining callers of the non-Detailed export.

quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-capability-lineage-smoke.ts:49 imports readPlaybooks from core/learning-store.js but never uses it (confirmed with --noUnusedLocals tsc pass and grep count=1, the import line itself).

quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/tasks/product-capability-release-smoke.ts:18 imports buildCapabilityReleaseRecord from core/capability-release.js but never uses it (the file uses createCapabilityReleaseRecordForTest instead throughout; confirmed with --noUnusedLocals tsc pass and grep count=1).

type-safety: packages/main/src/tasks/product-capability-release-smoke.ts:429-433 and :461-465 cast the createCapabilityReleaseHandlers argument object literal { root, store, scanRoot } as any even though it already satisfies HandlerContext (all other HandlerContext fields are optional). The mirrored precedent file tasks/artifact-release-ledger-smoke.ts:195-198 constructs the identical shape with no cast and compiles cleanly, so this as any is an avoidable type-safety regression versus the pattern this file claims to mirror.
